english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken verb for arriving or reaching a place.
Use 到 as the all-purpose choice for arriving at a place or point, extending as far as something, attaining something, or reaching an age.
Use 到 when the focus is arriving at a destination rather than moving toward someone.

examples.english: I arrive at the office at six.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 luk6 dim2 dou3 gung1 si1
ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 dou3 zo2 saan1 deng2

examples.english: We come to the station at eight.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baat3 dim2 sin1 dou3 ce1 zaam6
